mission: HEADROOM - PHASE 3 FINAL CLOSURE / PASS-A INVENTORY STABILITY + COMPLETION OF BLOCKED WHOLE-AGREEMENT VALIDATION
closureRuleApplied: Mission §26 requires ALL of gates A-R to pass. They do not (23-phase3-release-gate.json).

limitingLayer.why: Gate R fails on a demonstrated trust-boundary defect and that is the most severe finding of the mission: the third independent audit drove the real Pass A / Pass C / rollup functions and showed material operative text - a springing guarantee and all-assets lien grant, an absolute debt prohibition, four enumerated Lien carve-outs, a 30-day cure period, a maturity date, and a $75M cap inside an expanded definition - each dropped with INVENTORY_OK, uninventoriedSegments [], semanticallyComplete true, no failure reason, and an agreement rollup of SEMANTICALLY_COMPLETE. The v2 layer holds on the DETECTED path (a surfaced gap cannot be talked away - the auditor tried and failed) but its DETECTION path is five conjunctive filters, each individually sufficient to silence a material omission. 'Regression' is used here in the taxonomy's sense of a trust-boundary failure, not to imply the pre-v2 code was better: before v2 there was no operative-text accounting at all.

alsoBlocking.PASS_A_MODEL_STABILITY_LIMIT: Gate A fails on real evidence independently of the audit: semantic inventory stability 77.6% conservative / 64.8% strict-fold against a 95% gate, on the two source-identical v1 holdout runs, with PASS_A_MODEL_OMISSION as the measured earliest failure layer (04). Gate J likewise fails at 86.7% semantic label stability.
alsoBlocking.ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED: Gates C-I could not be measured at all: the Vercel AI Gateway credential returns HTTP 402 quota_for_entity_exceeded at $150.49 against a $150.00 limit, identical at the first and last check of this mission - independent confirmation that zero paid calls were made.

whatWasEstablishedThisMission: The 372-item Pass A variance population is classified end to end (01, 03): SOURCE_SPAN 196, GRANULARITY 108, ROLE 44, TRUE_SEMANTIC_VARIANCE 9, GENUINE_OMISSION 14, UNKNOWN 1.

Both stability numbers are reported side by side without moving the goalposts (02): STRICT_ID_STABILITY 18.88% inventory / 90.11% disposition-on-shared-ids; SEMANTIC_INVENTORY_STABILITY 90.4% lenient, 77.6% conservative (the gated figure), 64.8% strict-fold, 88.0% adjudicated (informational).
The earliest failure layer is measured, not inferred (04): source context, transport, the schema/excerpt gate and normalization are each ruled out with counts; PASS_A_MODEL_OMISSION is the residual.

One bounded architectural change was chosen and implemented (05 OPTION C): Pass A now accounts for operative TEXT it did not inventory, makes one targeted gap call, and reports any residue as INVENTORY_COVERAGE_GAP / uninventoriedSegments. Pass B, Pass C, the IR and the Phase 3C verifier are untouched.
Three independent audits were run by fresh agents; two returned blockers, both remediated inside the same bounded scope with tests, and production was re-frozen after each.
whatIsStillUnknown: Whether the v2 coverage accounting raises real-content semantic stability at all, and by how much: it is proven on synthetic material (169/169) and unmeasured on real content.
Whole-agreement CRITICAL/MATERIAL inventory recall, disposition rate, and value recall over all 12 regions (only 3 regions of run-1 ever completed, on the v1 SHA).
Real shared-cap / cross-reference dependency behaviour on real content (16).
Whether the gap re-inventory call closes surfaced gaps in practice or mostly leaves them surfaced - the difference between a stability fix and an honesty fix.

Whether the v2 layer's real-content behaviour is dominated by the detection-path holes above - on real credit-agreement prose the audit's finding 1 and finding 7 cases (ordinary 'will cause' drafting, extracted tables) are common, so the layer's measured effect could be substantially smaller than the synthetic corpus suggests.
whatThisIsNot: This is not a request for another giant validation cycle (§27). The single blocking input is provider budget. The completion path is bounded and already written down: 09's exact command twice for §14, then the pre-registered §15 manifest with --resume, then 11/12-17 recomputed from the run artifacts by scripts that already exist.
estimatedCostToComplete: ~$43 at the recorded per-region rates (08), for §14 (2 runs x pre-registered subset), §15 (run-1 regions 4-12 + full run-2), and §17.
phase4Readiness: NOT READY. Phase 4 depends on trusting a whole-agreement semantic accountability result; that result does not exist, and the one stability number that does exist is below its gate.

auditBacklog.note: Recorded, not remediated. Patching these would mean shipping further unaudited production changes past the final freeze in a mission whose gates have already failed, and findings 1/6/7/8 cannot be closed without redesigning the detection layer, which this mission's scope forbids (§9). This is the bounded backlog for whoever picks it up - not a proposal for another giant validation cycle (§27).

ordered.what: reconciliation.ts:426 - completeness counts only MONEY/PERCENT/RATIO; uncovered DAYS, PERIOD, DATE and MULTIPLIER values are silent. A dropped cure period, notice period, maturity date or incremental multiple is invisible.
the value gate is filtered to regionId === 'operative' and segments are computed for OPERATIVE regions only, so an inline expanded definition's cap, condition and pledge are all unaccounted.
a segment is eligible to be a gap only if it matches a closed connective vocabulary; ordinary drafting ('will cause', 'agrees to cause', 'undertakes') is an unconditional opt-out.

ordered.fix: a span-size / item-density check before ACCOUNTING_SPAN is trusted
ordered.what: one blanket CRITICAL item spanning a whole region reads clean on every accounting signal; a gap call that echoes the segment verbatim closes its own gap.
the 50% coverage threshold lets up to half of a boundary-free sentence vanish behind one accepted span.
a line break is a boundary only before an enumerator, so a line-broken reporting block or an extracted table is one segment and fails open twice over.

ordered.fix: floor calibration, with the corpus false-positive problem solved rather than traded away
ordered.what: the 40-char floor drops a 29-char absolute prohibition and four 26-35 char Lien carve-outs.
OPENS_WITH_CONDITIONAL_RE is anchored at ^, so an enumerator prefix ('(iv) except ...') defeats the conditional-tail floor the comment promises.

ordered.fix: add two constants to the cache key
ordered.what: the semantic-compiler cache key omits the accountability algorithm and prompt versions; harmless in-process today, a durable stale-verdict channel if the cache is moved to Postgres as its interface anticipates.
